directAuthorityTests: A module that proposes a write outside its declared authorityScope fails with authority_scope_violation.
The violating wave is rejected atomically before either authorized or unauthorized writes enter canonical state.
The receipt identifies module, wave, unauthorized key, and rejected proposed write.
The same violating run produces the same deterministic failure receipt.
A module writing only inside its declared authorityScope can converge normally.
claimBoundary: This proves enforcement for proposed module writes in the current deterministic executor. It does not establish a general security sandbox or process isolation boundary.
